answer: To curb Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce Proof-of-Space, requiring participants to allocate dedicated disk capacity recorded in a global identity atlas. Agents must continuously solve storage-bound challenges, imposing a verifiable hardware expenditure per active identity. This deters automated cloning whether nodes survey raven habitats or route municipal copper lines. However, this mechanism penalizes smaller agents by rewarding actors who control massive storage farms.
